changelog: Navigation was redesigned around a single All Functions menu. The tab strip and the bottom icon menu are gone: one bar under the header, titled All Functions and naming the function you are currently in, opens a dropdown listing all eleven functions in order, from Dashboard to Widgets. Tap a page name to switch pages — swiping between pages still works exactly as before — or tap Tests, Tools, Benchmark or Widgets to open them. The current page is highlighted in the list, the list scrolls on small screens, and the content of every function now fills the full screen.
